  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierOnboarding" name="Supplier Selection and Onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="New supplier need identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals (RFP)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveResponses" name="Receive supplier proposals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals on cost, quality and delivery time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitSplit" name="Site visits or interviews required?" default="Flow_SkipVisits">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConductVisits</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkipVisits</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductVisits" name="Conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConductVisits</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VisitsDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitJoin" name="Visit step completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VisitsDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkipVisits</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Select supplier after analysis">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract once terms are agreed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier and execute contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Onboarded" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveResponses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveResponses" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_VisitSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateContract" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="EndEvent_Onboarded"/>
